evals.name: solo-coupled-fix
evals.prompt: Decide the orchestration mode only; do not execute. Fix one null-pointer bug in src/cart.ts and run its focused test.

evals.name: parallel-independent-research
evals.prompt: Decide the orchestration mode only; do not execute. Research current official guidance for prompt design from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with separate cited findings that a lead will synthesize.
evals.expected_output: Parallel read-only scouts with bounded source lanes and one lead synthesis.

evals.name: serial-dependent-migration
evals.prompt: Decide the orchestration mode only; do not execute. Change the database schema, then update the API generated from it, then update the client that consumes the API.
evals.expected_output: Dependency-aware serial phases, not three simultaneous writers.
expectations: Identifies schema to API to client dependency
Does not start all writers in parallel

evals.name: parallel-connected-features
evals.prompt: Decide the orchestration mode only; do not execute. Build a backend endpoint and frontend screen in parallel; both depend on a new response schema and must land together.
evals.expected_output: Lead-owned interface contract followed by disjoint parallel implementation and integration.
expectations: Stabilizes response schema before parallel work
Defines replan trigger for interface change

evals.name: competing-diagnosis
evals.prompt: Decide the orchestration mode only; do not execute. An intermittent checkout failure has three plausible causes and no reliable reproduction yet; investigate without letting multiple agents edit the same files.
evals.expected_output: Read-only competing hypotheses with falsifiable evidence, then one owner implements.
expectations: Uses read-only competing hypotheses or bounded investigations

evals.name: same-file-collision
evals.prompt: Decide the orchestration mode only; do not execute. Three requested improvements all modify the same checkout component and its shared state logic.
evals.expected_output: One owner or serialized work, not parallel writers.
expectations: Assigns one owner or serial sequence

evals.name: reject-unverified-done
evals.prompt: You are the lead mid-run. A builder lane reports DONE with receipts claiming changes only to src/api/routes.ts, but the actual diff also touches src/auth/session.ts, which another lane owns. Decide what to do with this report.
evals.expected_output: Reject the DONE label: receipts fail validation against the diff, and the out-of-scope write must be resolved before integration.
expectations: Treats DONE as a claim pending receipt validation
Compares claimed changed files against the actual diff
Flags the write-scope violation on the other lane's file
Does not accept the report or integrate as-is

evals.name: interface-change-midflight
evals.prompt: You are the lead mid-run. Backend and frontend lanes are building in parallel against an agreed response schema when the backend lane finds the schema needs a new required field. Decide how to proceed.
evals.expected_output: Pause the affected lanes, update the interface contract and work map under lead ownership, then dispatch the smallest delta; do not let lanes continue against the stale schema.
expectations: Pauses affected lanes before further writes
Lead owns and approves the contract change
Updates the work map and interface contract
Dispatches the smallest delta instead of continuing unchanged

evals.name: repair-budget-exhausted
evals.prompt: You are the lead mid-run. A lane has failed its acceptance check twice with the same error, exhausting its two-attempt repair budget. Decide the next step.
evals.expected_output: No unchanged retry: change coordination mode, scope, or owner, or escalate with the failing receipts.
expectations: Recognizes the exhausted budget and recurring failure
Does not dispatch an unchanged retry
Changes mode, scope, or owner, or escalates
Carries the failing evidence and receipts forward

evals.name: single-owner-shared-file
evals.prompt: Choose the route only; do not execute. One lead is making two small related edits in one file. There are no other writers, independent lanes, security risk, ambiguity, release requirements, or user-requested reviewers.
evals.expected_output: Keep one owner and run focused combined verification on that file; no mandatory fresh checker just because two edits share it.
expectations: Does not invent a checker requirement from a single shared file
